views.label: All operations
views.alt: Addition, multiplication, and division: FloatLib median time divided by MPFR for binary arithmetic and by Stillwater Universal for posit arithmetic at equal encoded widths, on logarithmic axes. A ratio of 1 means equal time; above 1 means FloatLib took longer.

views.label: Addition
views.alt: Addition: FloatLib median time divided by the external implementation's median time against equal encoded width, on logarithmic axes. The horizontal line at 1 means equal time; above 1 means FloatLib took longer. Series: FloatLib binary / MPFR; FloatLib posit / Universal software. Ratios of 9-trial medians.
